data_source: Alpaca MCP SIP stock bars for the underlying signal

frozen_signal.entry: price > SMA200; SMA200 rising one session; Wilder RSI(2) < 10
frozen_signal.ranking: lowest RSI(2), maximum one entry per day, GOOG/GOOGL issuer deduplication
frozen_signal.underlying_exit: 15:45 price > EMA5 or 3 normal holding sessions
frozen_signal.signal_friction_model: 3 bps on entry and 3 bps on exit

options_execution.risk: 0.5% modeled stop-risk target; one-contract discrete exception capped at 2%; 20% equity premium cap; full paid premium is legal maximum loss
options_execution.monitor: 30-second underlying 2x ATR14 stop plus the frozen EMA5/time exit
options_execution.economic_gate: reject unless round-trip crossing plus square-root theta over the maximum holding period needs a smaller underlying move than the measured signal edge

limitations: The 2024, 2023, and 2026 headline figures validate the underlying timing signal, not option returns.
The 2026 option reconstruction covers 47% of signal trades and uses option bars, not historical bid/ask or Greeks; it is not a broker-fill replay.
Even at zero modeled friction the reconstructed long-call expression returns ~0%, so the negative conclusion does not depend on the friction assumption.
The carry gate uses a single measured edge constant; it bounds obvious losers, it does not create an edge.
Historical option slippage and IV movement are not represented by the stock-signal proxy.
Alpaca get_news is not an independently verified earnings calendar.
Paper staging is not evidence of production alpha or future profitability.
decision_note: The underlying timing signal is positive and frequent. The long-call expression of it is not: reconstructed on historical Alpaca option bars it returns roughly zero before friction and loses after it. The lane is therefore funded only from a small reserve, sized so it can demonstrate the end-to-end options lifecycle, and every contract must now clear a carry gate before entry.

option_expression_2026_ytd.finding: no measurable edge before friction; negative after it
reconstruction_limitations: Alpaca MCP exposes historical option trades/bars but not historical bid/ask quotes or Greeks.
Delta is inferred from the completed 15-minute option trade bar with Black-Scholes (4% rate, 1% dividend yield).
Contract selection cannot reproduce the live relative-spread gate; friction scenarios replace that unavailable field.
Results are an option-bar reconstruction, not broker-fill or exact quote replay.

carry_arithmetic.why_the_option_expression_fails: A long call must pay round-trip crossing plus holding-period theta before the signal's direction is worth anything. Measured on the live Alpaca chain, an 18-DTE 0.69-delta AAPL call at 13.49/13.95 with spot 313.89 carries $133.60 per contract over a three-session hold - $46.00 of crossing and $87.60 of theta - which needs a +0.61% underlying move just to break even. The signal's measured mean move is +0.795%. The margin is 1.3x on the most liquid contract available, and negative on most of the rest.
carry_arithmetic.conclusion: Buying a call pays the same variance risk premium the credit-spread lane collects. The 15% relative-spread gate admitted contracts whose bid/ask alone exceeded what the signal could pay, so the gate was tightened to 6% and a per-contract carry test was added.
